header.title: BorderBeam
header.description: Neon ray that travels around the container border. `variant` sets the ray shape, `trigger` when it runs and `length` how long it is. With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the ray stays still at `offset`.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine props and see the generated code. `length` set to `auto` uses each `variant`'s default length.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `orbit` is a single traveling ray, `dual` two opposite rays, `spark` a short hot head, `trace` a long comet tail and `track` adds a dim border along the ray's path.

card.title: On a Card
card.description: `BorderBeam` wraps a gem-system `Card`. Give the root the same `border-radius` as the card so the ray follows its corners.

texts.title: Team plan
texts.subtitle: Recommended
texts.body: Up to 20 people, roles and centralized billing.

triggers.title: Hover and click
triggers.description: With `trigger` set to `hover`, the ray runs while the pointer (or focus) is on the element. With `click`, each click turns it on or off.

geometry.title: Thickness and length
geometry.description: `thickness` is the stroke width (a number is pixels). `length` is the ray length as a percentage of the loop, between `8` and `70`.

motion.title: Speed and direction
motion.description: `duration` is one full loop in milliseconds. `reverse` makes it travel counter-clockwise.

offset.title: Starting angle
offset.description: `offset` is the starting angle in degrees. Shown here with `isPaused` to see where each one starts. It's also the fixed position under reduced motion.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: `intensity` sets the ray opacity and, for `track`, the dim border's. Takes a token or a number between `0` and `1`.

color.title: Colors
color.description: `color` is the ray body and `colorAlt` its head. With `dual`, `colorAlt` is also the second ray's color.

asChild.title: asChild
asChild.description: With `asChild`, the effect is applied to the child without adding a `div`. Here, on a native `button` with `trigger="hover"`: the ray also shows on keyboard focus.

state.title: Paused and disabled
state.description: `isPaused` freezes the ray where it is. `isDisabled` hides it and keeps the content interactive.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onBorderBeam` fires when the ray turns on and `outBorderBeam` when it turns off, with the cause in `event.reason`. The layer doesn't block interaction: the button still gets clicks.

styled.title: Rainbow
styled.body: The ray gradient, redefined in your own class.

header.title: BorderBeam API
header.description: Reference for `BorderBeam` props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for each variant and trigger.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/border-beam` with its `border-beam.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> except color, and passes them to the root div (or the child, with asChild). onClick, onPointerEnter and onPointerLeave run before the effect's own logic.

items.hidden: The ray layer has aria-hidden and pointer-events: none: it's decorative and doesn't block the child.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the ray stops spinning and stays at the offset angle.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) forces the animation. Use it only when motion is essential.
items.focus: With trigger="hover", the ray also shows on :focus-within, so keyboard users see it. onBorderBeam only fires for the pointer.
items.click: With trigger="click", the toggle listens to click on the root. If the child is a button, Enter and Space work too.
items.meaning: The ray is decoration: don't use it as the only state cue (featured, loading). Pair it with text or an ARIA attribute.
items.minify: The ring uses a composite mask. Some minifiers reorder it and show the whole gradient: check it with the production build (this site declares the composition inside the mask shorthand).

items.trigger: Active trigger. Hides the layer until hover/focus or click.
items.inactive: Added with `isActive={false}` or `isDisabled`; hides the layer.
items.disabled: Added with `isDisabled`. Removes the pointer cursor.
items.layer: Absolute layer over the child holding the dim border and the ring.
items.ring: Masked ring as thick as `thickness`, with the glow (`drop-shadow`).
items.spin: Rotating conic gradient that draws the ray.
items.spinAlt: Second ray, offset by half a loop. Only with `variant="dual"`.
items.surface: Wraps the child, below the layer.

items.colorAlt: Head and second-ray color. Set by `colorAlt`; default `var(--gem-palette-secondary-400)`.
items.duration: One full loop. Set by `duration`; default `3600ms`.
items.delay: Delay before starting. Set by `delay`; default `0ms`.
items.span: Ray length as a percentage of the loop. Set by `length`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables BorderBeam reads as defaults.

items.palette: Default `color` and `colorAlt`, with a neon fallback when gem-system isn't loaded.
items.spark: Extra white glow of the `spark` variant.

content.title: Content
content.description: Which container the ray travels and where the effect mounts.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Ray shape, colors, thickness, length and intensity.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: Loop speed and direction, in milliseconds.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: When the ray runs and how it pauses or turns off.

items.children: Container whose border the ray travels.
items.asChild: Applies the effect to the single child, without a wrapping `div`. The child needs its own `border-radius`.
items.color: Ray color. Prefer host tokens (`var(--gem-palette-primary-400)`). An empty string uses the default.
items.colorAlt: Head color and, with `dual`, the second ray's color.
items.thickness: Stroke width. A number is pixels; a string is used as is.
items.length: Ray length as a percentage of the loop, clamped to `8`–`70`. Without a value, it depends on `variant`: `orbit` 18, `dual` 14, `spark` 8, `trace` 38, `track` 16.
items.intensity: Ray strength: token or number between `0` and `1`.
items.duration: One full loop. Negative values become `0`.
items.trigger: `always` keeps running, `hover` while the pointer or focus is on it, `click` toggles on each click.
items.isActive: Shows the ray. `false` hides it and `outBorderBeam` gets `inactive`.
items.isPaused: Freezes the ray at its current position.
items.isDisabled: Hides the ray; the child stays interactive. `outBorderBeam` gets `disabled`.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Animates even when the user prefers reduced motion. Only when motion is essential.
items.onBorderBeam: Fires when the ray turns on: on mount with `always`, on pointer enter with `hover` or when toggled on with `click`.
items.outBorderBeam: Fires when the ray turns off: on pointer leave, when toggled off with `click`, when disabled or on unmount.
items.style: Root inline styles. Merged with the `--gemfx-border-beam-*` variables.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
